title: plantago myosuros subsp. humilior
intro: Plantago myosuros subsp. humilior, commonly known as the small-leaved plantain or small plantain, is a subspecies of the plantain plant, which is a type of flowering plant in the plantain family (Plantaginaceae). This plant is used in traditional medicine due to its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, making it effective in soothing wounds, reducing inflammation, and fighting infections. The therapeutic actions of Plantago myosuros subsp. humilior include its ability to reduce swelling, promote wound healing, and exhibit antispasmodic and anti-diarrheal effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and polysaccharides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
